description: A woman has $100000 to gamble on two sports bets: a basketball tournament, a horse race, and a soccer game. Based on simple analysis, the woman determines her chance of losing her money would be 50% for basketball tournament, 25% for horse race, and 10% for the soccer game. The payout for each dollar put on each bet will be $1.2 for basketball tournament, $0.5 for horse race, and $0.1 for the soccer game. Knowing herself, she limits her average chance of losing her money should be at most 30%. Could you help her determine how much to money to put on each sport bet to maximize her average payout?

TotalMoney.definition: Total amount of money available to gamble

LossProbabilities.definition: Chance of losing money for each sport bet

Payouts.definition: Payout per dollar for each sport bet

MaxAverageLossProbability.definition: Maximum average chance of losing money

objective.description: "Maximize the total payout obtained from allocating the $100,000 among the three sports bets."
objective.code: model.setObjective(quicksum(Payouts[i] * BetAmounts[i] for i in range(NumBets)), GRB.MAXIMIZE)

constraints.description: The total amount of money allocated to all bets should not exceed TotalMoney
constraints.code: model.addConstr(sum(BetAmounts[i] for i in range(NumBets)) <= TotalMoney)

constraints.description: The sum over all bets of LossProbabilities[i] * MoneyAllocated[i] should be less than or equal to MaxAverageLossProbability * TotalMoney
constraints.code:
model.addConstr(
    sum(LossProbabilities[i] * BetAmounts[i] for i in range(NumBets))
    <= MaxAverageLossProbability * TotalMoney
)

constraints.description: The amount of money allocated to each bet should be non-negative

BetAmounts.definition: Amount of money allocated to each sport bet
